subject: Matemática
description_pt: Reconhecer vistas ortogonais de figuras espaciais e aplicar esse conhecimento para desenhar objetos em perspectiva.

components.description_pt: Identificar vistas ortográficas (frontal, lateral e superior) de figuras tridimensionais
components.description_en: Identify orthographic views (front, side, and top) of three-dimensional figures
components.cc_component_description: Describe and identify the two-dimensional figures that result from slicing a three-dimensional figure by a plane perpendicular to one of the faces

components.description_pt: Relacionar uma figura tridimensional às suas vistas ortográficas correspondentes
components.description_en: Match a three-dimensional figure to its corresponding orthographic views

components.description_pt: Desenhar um objeto tridimensional em perspectiva usando conhecimento de vistas ortográficas
components.description_en: Draw a three-dimensional object in perspective using orthographic view knowledge

cc_matches.description: Describe the two-dimensional figures that result from slicing three-dimensional figures, as in plane sections of right rectangular prisms and right rectangular pyramids.
